reuse.reason: The pinned AccountSection exports the official complete account cards only through its credential or active-attempt branches. Its genuine signed-out branch returns a centered sign-in prompt, with no exported presentation option for unavailable account cards. The user requested those complete cards remain visible while unavailable, with a separate Dsh-base sign-in action below. A complete runtime fork adds only optional presentation=full-unavailable for genuine signed-out state with no attempt. It retains the default auto behavior, original registration, dictionaries, assets and CSS; no credential or attempt is fabricated, no private read is added, and unavailable Platform anchors have no navigation target or Host click handler. The local sign-in extension remains in the separate account-launcher plugin. A type-only AccountOnboarding import follows the deployed client-deepseek-provider replacement to share its settings.models namespace, avoiding a duplicate augmentation from the disabled original.
gaps: This revision limits the workbench to authenticated accounts. The anonymous homepage uses the isolated sign-in and consent document providers.
